messages.subject: Error in groupComparison
parts:
Dear MSstats-Team,

I am trying to run the groupComparison function in R but i get the following error:
Error in MSstatsContrastMatrix.data.frame(contrast.matrix, groups) :
  Assertion on 'colnames of contrast matrix' failed: Must be a permutation of set {}, but has extra elements {'background','no_lesion','outlier','QSZHGE_high','QSZHGE_low'}.

However, i checked that the colnames of the groupcomparison are identical with the actual groups.
> colnames(Comparison_matrix)
[1] "background"  "no_lesion"   "outlier"     "QSZHGE_high" "QSZHGE_low"

 > levels(MSstats_quant_wo_iRT$ProteinLevelData$GROUP)
[1] "background"  "no_lesion"   "outlier"     "QSZHGE_high" "QSZHGE_low"


Do you have any idea where the issue could be?

messages.subject: Re: Error in groupComparison

Dear MSstats-team,

Solved, it seemed to be some kind of memory issue, the MSstats_quant_wo_iRT object did not contain any entries...
Restarting Rstudio and rerunning the previous parts solved the issue! =)
